VALIDATION: Present requires successful clock-in and clock-out.
Complete requires actual material usage and QC evidence.
Completion requires nonnegative actual yield; expected yield is never substituted.
Unexplained quantity or cash variance blocks reconciliation.
A trip cannot be delivered or closed without POD evidence.
Maker cannot approve their own controlled request; decision reason is required.
Posting requires finite equal debit and credit values in an open period.
Approval alone creates no active commitment. Ordered and partial-received balances do.
Accepted plus rejected quantity equals delivered quantity.
Human approval and explicit Publish permission precede any simulated publication.
No assignment means no disclosure; missing and unauthorized resources share a neutral result.
Export, Pay, Publish and other specialized actions are explicit, never implied by a level.
No arbitrary SQL/JavaScript; protected business invariants cannot be disabled.
Transfer closure requires received quantity equal to dispatched quantity.
Closure requires the full issued quantity returned.
Net pay, bank validation, statutory configuration and approval are separate gates.
Opening a screen never sends a message; sends require an authorized event or an approved manual flow with idempotency, consent and audit.
AI may draft, but a manually initiated customer communication follows Generate, Preview, Edit, Approve, Send.
Provider credentials, signatures, webhook verification and retries belong in production server-side adapters, never the frontend.
A bank notification alone cannot activate service; verified provider event, match, authoritative payment state and applicable business rule are all required.
Create, approve, execute and reconcile are separate grants; a maker cannot approve their own controlled transfer.
Batch submission does not mark employees paid; success or reversal is applied per employee and reconciled before final state.
Unassigned accounts, balances, transactions, beneficiaries, payroll batches, reports and their derived counts are absent from every surface.
